prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1019; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is being made for the claim file. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: Sure. I'm the claimant, and I'll just go by the policyholder's account on this one.

Q: That's fine, we'll keep it simple. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot in League City, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space near the main entrance when the other vehicle backed out of the space across from me.

Q: Was your vehicle moving at the time of impact?

A: I had just started rolling, maybe a few miles an hour. I had already checked my mirror, but the other car came out faster than I expected.

Q: Did you see the other driver before the collision?

A: Not really. I saw a shape move, then I heard the impact. I hit the brakes but it was too late.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I threw my arm out to brace myself against the steering wheel and my wrist took most of the force. I was taken to urgent care, and they told me it was fractured. I'm wearing a splint now and I'm supposed to see a specialist next week.

Q: Did you have any passengers in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Has a police report been filed?

A: Yes, an officer came to the scene and took information from both drivers. I can get you the report number.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: I just want to make sure my medical bills get covered. I've already missed a few days of work because I can't drive with this wrist.

Q: Understood. We'll follow up with you about the medical records and the claim. Thank you for your cooperation.

A: Thanks. I appreciate it.
